high: The temporary runner obtains owner._live_backend directly and invokes observe, private _a90ctl, and rollback flash outside the minimal owner's reviewed transaction, active-run guard, candidate guard, journal validation, and effect-lease checks. Neither the binding A90 target contract nor GOAL_A90 names or activates an H37 temporary-demo capability, so a new script and review cannot create live D1/F1 authority.

The runner begins status, verify, and play device effects without first opening, hashing, and retaining an exact BoundArtifact lease for the V2321 rollback. Manifest text alone does not satisfy the permanent requirement that exact rollback bytes be present, readable, hash-verified, and usable before device effects.

Mandatory rollback is not cut-safe. Any exit or host interruption after 00-approved publication and before terminal publication leaves RUN_DIR present, while every later execute invocation rejects an existing RUN_DIR. There is no audit, resume, or rollback-only finalizer for cuts before rollback intent, between rollback intent and launch, during the rollback helper, after rollback result, or during final health observation.

The custom approval is timeless and binds only manifest, review, and source-closure hashes. prepare performs no current target or health observation, and execute has no exact attended assertion, expiry, or durable approval-to-current-device binding. It therefore cannot establish the fresh attended authority required for the later demo commands and intentional rollback.

load_inputs validates the manifest structure and the temporary review but never calls the minimal owner's qualification-input verifier. The qualification review file, current owner closure lease, recovery/hazard object, and recovery evidence can therefore be missing or drifted when this runner creates its backend and starts contact.
medium: The separate verify command can establish the preset stream hash at one instant, but play is deliberately issued with --trust-cache and performs no hash check. The mutable cache path is reopened after the verify/play gap, so the runner does not bind the played bytes to the verified 150490668-byte stream under one device-side lease.

The claimed PROVED result uses substring checks. In particular, video.stream.presented=300 also matches video.stream.presented=3000, and the status and verify texts are not parsed into exact semantic journal facts. Only text and receipt hashes are retained in the journal.

The five focused tests pass, but they inspect constants, string counts, and the absence of a while True token. They contain no exception/cut matrix, consumed-prefix recovery tests, rollback-artifact drift tests, stale-approval tests, qualification-review drift tests, cache substitution tests, or adversarial exact-marker fixtures.

Independent host reconstruction supports only designed-unproved construction: H37 is an equal-length identity substitution of the exact V3402 init, the unpacked non-ramdisk components and cpio metadata listing match, and the candidate hash is exact. V3402 live evidence proves its historical resident and display service state, not this new H37 boot, current cache contents, Bad Apple playback, intentional rollback, or final V2321 health.
